description: Shell default: native networking for the Device Host adapter. HTTPS is allowed anywhere; plain HTTP only for loopback and private LAN IPv4 (10/8, 127/8, 169.254/16, 172.16/12, 192.168/16) so LAN OpenAI-compatible gateways work. The Android release manifest keeps usesCleartextTraffic=false because Provider traffic goes through the Rust HTTP plugin's raw sockets, not the WebView/Java networking stack, so Android's cleartext policy does not apply.
